newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan on Centocor.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan on Centocor.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Eric Hecht said he reiterated his strong buy rating on Centocor Inc due to his expectations for its anti-inflamatory drug CenTNF.

-- He said the drug for treating Crohn's disease, a severe inflamatory bowel condition, and rheumatoid arthritis, could be a "big opportunity" for Centocor, with peak annual sales reaching $500 million.
-- He said the peak sales could be reached in four to five years from the product's expected launch in 1998.
-- He raised his price target on the stock to $51 from $40. The stock rose five to 34.
